segments.name: Farmland
segments.description: Owns and leases high-quality U.S. farmland to farm operators, earning fixed and variable rent and crop sales.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has identified a single operating segment which is the entire entity for reporting purposes in accordance with GAAP and no aggregation of segments is required.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under farm leases, and the company also earns crop sales, tenant reimbursements, solar and wind rent and loan interest.
revenueModel.evidence: Our principal source of revenue is rent from tenants that conduct farming operations on our farmland pursuant to leases with terms ranging primarily from one to three years.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company sold MWA, its auction, brokerage and third-party management business, to a third party.
changes.evidence: In November 2025, we sold MWA to a third party, and therefore no longer operate these businesses.
